name: Musket, Double-Barreled
body:
A double-barrel musket functions identically to a normal musket in all ways, except that it can be fired twice before it needs to be reloaded. Anyone proficient with muskets is proficient with double-barrel muskets. Upgrades such as masterwork quality or rifling must be applied to each barrel individually, but it must be applied to both barrels if it is applied. Note that both barrels of a double-barreled weapon can be loaded with a single full-round action.
